finance.about: About debt, savings, income and support
finance.title: Money through the years.
finance.intro: I want to be open about money as well as work. Debt, savings and income all have a place in this story. There’s no shame in having debt, and talking about income or savings shouldn’t be taboo.
finance.supportIntro: You don’t have to work it out on your own. These organisations can help you find a starting point.
finance.fallback: Start with your local government or social services and ask about recognised debt-advice services in your area.
finance.footnote: Services, fees and eligibility vary. Check with the organisation before starting.
